channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Vance says Israeli campaign tried to sway US opinion against Iran diplomacy
item.description: The US vice-president also said he faced 'vicious' personal attacks over his diplomatic outreach to end war.

item.title: Israeli attacks kill at least five Palestinians in Gaza despite ‘ceasefire’
item.description: Attacks continue in violation of the October agreement with more than 1,100 Palestinians killed since then.

item.title: Data breach reportedly targets India’s Kudankulam nuclear power plant
item.description: Purported blueprints of parts of India's largest plant exposed by World Leaks ransomware group, Reuters reports.

item.title: US or Iran — Who needs a new truce deal more?
item.description: Both sides face pressure points that could make a protracted war painful.

item.title: Palestinians in Gaza search through homes destroyed by Israeli strikes
item.description: Palestinians are inspecting the damage in Nuseirat after Israeli strikes reduced their homes to rubble.

item.title: Iran claims strikes on US bases, warns of wider attacks on region
item.description: Iran claims strikes on US bases, warns of wider attacks on region

item.title: ‘Destroyed my whole life’: Lebanese families wiped out in Israeli attacks
item.description: Hussein Saleh describes an Israeli air attack in Tyre that killed his family, including his wife and his only child.

item.title: Italian officials handed jail terms for Genoa bridge disaster that killed 43
item.description: The ex-head of Italy's motorway operator Giovanni Castellucci was handed a 12-year term over the 2018 bridge collapse.

item.title: Iran targets military bases as US launches wave of strikes
item.description: Explosions were heard across Iran overnight, shortly after neighbouring Gulf states began to report attacks.

item.title: Russian attacks kill 14 as Ukraine hits Black Sea oil tankers
item.description: Civilian casualties are reported in a number of Ukrainian regions, while Kyiv hits 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea.
